x-m-e1-06.title: Chinhu chiri mubhokisi chine chimiro chipi?
x-m-e1-06.goal: Nguva imwe neimwe unowana chinoratidza chimwe, dzikisa zvimiro zvinogona kuitika uye gadzirisa pfungwa yako yekutanga kuti ienderane nechinoratidza chitsva.
x-m-e1-06.material: Uri kuvharirwa maziso uchibata chinhu mubhokisi, uye unonzwa zvinoratidza chimwe nechimwe. Chinhu chiri mubhokisi chimwe chechimiro chebhokisi, chimiro che cylinder, kana chimiro che bhora.
x-m-e1-06.thinking.2: Kufananidza kuti mirayiridzo ipi inosiyanisa zvimiro zvakanakisa

x-m-e1-06.s.s1.prompt: Mirayiridzo inoratidzwa imwe nenguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza pfungwa yako.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora chimiro chebhokisi, chimiro checylinder, nechimiro chebhora, uye pamurayiridzo mumwe nemumwe cheka zvimiro zvinogoneka.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.hint.1: Funga imwe nenguva kuti murayiridzo mumwe nemumwe unobvisa zvimiro zvipi.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.0.info: Murayiridzo 1: Pandakachisundira nechanza changu, chakamhanya chakamhanya.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana chichimhanya, hachingaiti chimiro chebhokisi. Chimiro chebhora nechimiro checylinder zvinosara.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Chimiro checylinder chinomhanyawo kana ukachirara padivi ukachisundira. Wakasarudza kugoneka kumwe chete nekukurumidza.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Chimiro chebhokisi chine zviso zvakawanda zvakaenzana, saka kana ukachisundira, chinotsvedza uye chinonetseka kumhanya.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Chingava chimiro chebhora kana chimiro checylinder.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Haugoni kuziva chinhu kubva pamurayiridzo mumwe chete.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Unogona kuita kuti chimiro chebhokisi chisagoneke zvakanyanya. Murayiridzo hauna basa.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.1.info: Murayiridzo 2: Ndakaisa chinhu pasi ndikaisa bhuku pamusoro pacho, bhuku harina kuwira ndokumira rakagadzikana.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.1.after: Kuti bhuku rimire pamusoro, pamusoro panofanira kuva pakaenzana. Chimiro chebhora hachina chikamu chakaenzana. Chimiro checylinder chakanyanya kugoneka.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Uchiri kusakwanisa kusiyanisa chimiro chebhora nechimiro checylinder.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Haina kushandisa murayiridzo mutsva wekuti bhuku rinomira rakagadzikana. Pabhora, bhuku rinodonha nyore.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Murayiridzo 1 wakati chakamhanya, saka hachikodzeri zvakanaka chimiro chebhokisi.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakashandisa murayiridzo mutsva kusarudza chimiro chine pamusoro pakaenzana. Wakagadzirisa pfungwa yako.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Murayiridzo 3: Ndakanzwa chiso apo bhuku rakange riri, uye chakaenzana, chimiro chakatenderera.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana chine chiso chakaenzana, chakatenderera, chimiro checylinder. Kamucheka kechinwiwa nekamucheka kefish zvose zvinokodzera.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Marbles chimiro chebhora, saka hachina chiso chakaenzana.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Chimiro checylinder chine pamusoro pakaenzana, pakatenderera.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Chimiro checylinder chine pamusoro pakaenzana, pakatenderera.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Dhayisi chimiro chebhokisi, saka zviso zvayo isquares.
x-m-e1-06.s.s1.reflect: Mashandiro ezvimiro zvinogoneka akasiyana sei kana uchiziva murayiridzo 1 chete uye kana uchiziva kusvika kumurayiridzo 2? Kana waitanga wafunga "chimiro chebhora chete," ndeupi murayiridzo wakakuchinjisa pfungwa?
x-m-e1-06.s.s2.prompt: Mune rimwe bhokisi muna chinhu chiri chimiro chebhokisi kana chimiro checylinder. Kana ukabvunza mubvunzo mumwe chete uchinge wakasungirwa maziso, ndeupi mubvunzo wakanakisa wekusiyanisa zviviri izvi?
x-m-e1-06.s.s2.hint.0: Funga chimiro chimwe chebhokisi nechimiro chimwe checylinder, uye pamubvunzo mumwe nemumwe nyora kana mhinduro dzezvimiro zviviri dzakafanana kana dzakasiyana.
x-m-e1-06.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kana mubvunzo une zvimiro zviviri zvose zvichipindura "hongu" ungabatsira kusiyanisa zviviri.
x-m-e1-06.s.s2.o.a: Chiso chakaenzana chakatenderera here kana isquare?
x-m-e1-06.s.s2.r.a: Unobvunza nezve chimiro chinopa mhinduro dzakasiyana kuzvimiro zviviri.
x-m-e1-06.s.s2.r.b: Chimiro chebhokisi nechimiro checylinder zvose zvine zviso zvakaenzana, saka zvose zvinopindura "hongu." Haungaisi kusiyanisa zviviri.
x-m-e1-06.s.s2.r.c: Ruvara harina chekuita nechimiro, saka hagoni kusiyanisa zvimiro.
x-m-e1-06.s.s2.explain: Zviso zvakaenzana zvechimiro chebhokisi isquares, uye zviso zvakaenzana zvechimiro checylinder idenderedzwa. Mubvunzo wakanaka ndiwo unopindurwa zvakasiyana nezvimiro zviviri. Kana pane chiso chakaenzana kunobuda "hongu" kuzvimiro zvose, saka hazvigoni kuzvisiyanisa.
